part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `ACLSelectorRemoveCommandRule` (src/server.c:3270): when a rule was removed via `memmove`, the scan pointer advanced to `copy_end`, which was stale after the string shifted — so any remaining rules that also matched (e.g. `-config|set` when adding `+config`) were skipped and left in the retained `command_rules`, making `ACL LIST`/`ACL GETUSER` output disagree with the actual command bitmap.

The fix sets `existing_rule = copy_position` and `continue` after the `memmove`, matching the upstream behavior.

Verified:
- Issue scenario `+config|get -config|set` then `+config` now yields `-@all +config` (previously `-@all -config|set +config`)
- `./runtest --single unit/acl` — all tests pass, including the regression test for #12470 (`-@all +config +config|get -config|set +config` → `-@all +config`)
- `./runtest --single unit/introspection-2` — all tests pass
